title: ポケットモンスター 青

versions.note: the Japanese Blue cartridge (POKEMON BLUE, header checksum 0xE5)

sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on mGBA (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The cartridge and snaps were studied outside it

From Pocket Monsters Aka (games/gb/GB-29D07340.lua): the script and the table, unchanged but for this cartridge's header. This cartridge's font, at 0x11B81, has Aka's glyphs under all 127 codes, found offline; Aka's presses, replayed here, reached the same stretches

Played from the opening's talk through the rival's naming and the end of the opening, the hero's mother at home, and the professor in the grass and his lab: four stretches, each replayed from a state with the script loaded
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 43 of 43 pictures, over 4 scenes; 2 pages said inside a press have no picture. No screen without text was among them
The rows were the script's pages, each held against its picture (compare's scrolls)

The rival's fight in the lab was played with advance_through on the fight's mode byte (0xD034: 0 on the field, 2 in a fight). The game shows a Super Game Boy border, so a page typing changes too little of the picture for still_share's default; at 0.002, A alone won the fight in 104 presses
With the fight's cursor first put on the items command, A opened that list over and over, and the cycle check stopped it after 33 presses
88 harness calls in all (by the record), none failed
notes: Read by the script games/gb/GB-65EF364B.lua: the message window's two rows while the window shows, when the page waits on its arrow or has stood half a second; and a page the game hides before that, when it hides it. Not read: who speaks but where the game writes it into the text, menus and other boxes, battles (their text not compared). Names chosen in play come out as typed.
